paragraphs.source_en: And so he was now overseeing the introduction of investment by the American-based transnationals, a responsibility that made him manic with overwork and puffed up with power, what John thought of as the business version of Sax, always moving, always gesturing with his hands as if conducting the music of his speech, which had shifted over the years to full-tilt Chamber of Commerce overdrive, "Got to stake a claim on the Escarpment before the transnats and the Germans snap everything up, lotta work to be done!" which was his constant refrain, often said while pointing for illustration at the little globe he carried with him in his lectern pocket.
